title: rAthena inter_server.yml — premium storage definitions
description: JSON port of rAthena conf/inter_server.yml. Each storage entry is a separate SQL-backed bag of items the player can access via the openstorage2 script command. Storage id 0 is the default account storage and is always present; additional entries are VIP / event / premium storages.

storages.description: Premium storage definitions. Order does not matter; lookup is by id.

id.description: Storage id. 0 = default account storage. 1+ = premium / event storages referenced by openstorage2 <id>.

name.description: Display name shown on the storage window title bar.

table.description: Name of the SQL table backing this storage. Must follow the column shape of the default `storage` table.

max.description: Maximum item count for this storage. Premium storage max is NOT modified by vip_storage_increase or MIN_STORAGE.
